newsitem.title: USA: Hilton has 710,000 ITT shares, extends bid.
newsitem.headline: Hilton has 710,000 ITT shares, extends bid.

text.p: Hilton Hotels Corp. said Friday that it had received about 710,000 ITT Corp. shares in response to its $6.5 billion tender offer, which it extended until March 28.
The offer was originally due to expire Friday.
New York-based ITT, which has rejected Hilton's cash and stock offer, has about 122.7 million shares outstanding.
ITT said Thursday that it planned to add 28 hotels to its core Sheraton chain in an effort to battle Beverly Hills, Calif.-based Hilton's hostile bid.
Hilton's stock edged up 12.5 cents to $24.625 and ITT fell 12.5 cents to $56.25 on the New York Stock Exchange at midday.
